action.objective: Verify the reserved tactic Qxf4 at depth 4, checking that recapturing the loose knight Nf4 is safe against Black's replies.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave Qxf4 an exact score of 21, top of the list, and the line d7e5/f4e5 shows Black's knight recapturing. But depth 2 with cutoff is shallow; the queen may be exposed to ...Nxe5 or ...Bd6 ideas. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 will confirm or refute Qxf4 before committing, since Nf4 is an undefended knight and the queen recapture is concrete material gain but may cost tempo or allow counterplay.
